title: My Morning and Evening
text:
I get up at seven o'clock every morning. First, I brush my teeth and wash my face. Then I eat breakfast with my family. I like toast and a cup of tea.

At eight o'clock I go to work by bus. I work in an office. In the evening I come home and cook dinner. I go to bed at ten o'clock.

questions.text: What time does the person get up?
How does the person go to work?
What can we guess about the person's evening?
options: They work late at the office

questions.text: What can we guess about the person's routine?
options: It is the same each day

paragraph_translations: Wstaję o siódmej każdego ranka. Najpierw myję zęby i twarz. Potem jem śniadanie z rodziną. Lubię tosty i filiżankę herbaty.
O ósmej jadę do pracy autobusem. Pracuję w biurze. Wieczorem wracam do domu i gotuję kolację. Kładę się spać o dziesiątej.
